title: Optimize adaptive slot arbitration and KV quiescence to reduce prefetch thrash
creator: Ava Chen
description: Context: We continue to see intermittent latency spikes and increased GPU token cost on medium-concurrency workloads caused by oscillation between aggressive prefetching and conservative slot arbitration. The current arbitration loop awards slots to inflight aggregates without considering recent KV cache churn and eviction storms, which causes repeated prefetch thrash and redundant KV lookups. This ticket untangles the slot arbitration heuristics, introduces a short-lived KV quiescence window to suppress redundant prefetches after eviction events, and rebalances admission backpressure to smooth throughput under bursty ingress. The aim is to reduce tail latency and token cost without sacrificing steady-state throughput.
acceptance_criteria: Median and 95th percentile latency on benchmark 'chat-medium' reduced by at least 10% and 15% respectively compared to baseline
End-to-end token cost per 1M tokens reduced by >= 6% under representative mixed workload (conversational + long-context)
No regression in throughput for high-concurrency steady-state tests (+/- 3%)
New telemetry exposes eviction-triggered quiescence events and arbitration decision traces in Console
Unit + integration tests for arbitration policy and KV quiescence added and running in CI
technical_notes: Introduce 'quiescence' flag on KV shard metadata that is set for 200-500ms after large compaction/eviction runs and observed hotkey churn
Modify slot allocator to consult recent quiescence windows: deprioritize prefetch-heavy allocations for shards with active quiescence
Add moving-average counters for 'prefetch success ratio' per shard to avoid punting on short-lived anomalies
Implement admission hysteresis at the scheduler boundary: only escalate admission after two consecutive successful allocation cycles
Backwards-compatible config flags for rollout: runtime.config.arbitration_quiescence_ms and runtime.config.prefetch_min_success_rate
Benchmark harness added to perf/benchmarks/slot_arbitration to run mixed workload traces and collect token cost metrics
decisions: Prefer short quiescence windows (200-500ms) to avoid long cold periods that hurt steady-state throughput
Do not disable prefetch globally; instead, make it shard-aware and probabilistic during quiescence
Rollout as a feature-flagged change with canary on 5% of capacity, monitor Console metrics before wider rollout
